limits: Per-exchange local monotonic durations only; no cross-host timestamp subtraction.
Nested spans and independent maxima must not be added to estimate full input-to-display latency.
B-to-A natural return is represented by A SourceDeactivate, not an independent B-source lease.
Retained profiles are bounded samples; last profile is earlier than collection, and control.previous is incomplete.
Pre-connect acquisition retries during installation are separated from established-connection failures.
No instrumented physical-input-to-display measurement or controlled performance experiment.
